note: RFC 4271 Section 9.1.2: "The local speaker SHALL then install that route in the Loc-RIB, replacing any route to the same destination that is currently being held in the Loc-RIB." Re-judged 2026-10-26 by an independent auditor: TestRIBBestChangeWithdraw lost its tag; the remaining carriers are TestRFC4271SelectedRouteReplacesTheLocRIBRoute and TestRFC4271LocRIBHoldsOnlyTheReplacingRoute (receive path through handleReceivedStructured, byte-identical to the units judged before) and TestLocRIBMirror (supplementary positive: checkBestPathChange installs the best in a locrib with eBGP admin distance and NEXT_HOP). Positive: peer B's better route replaces peer A's as the Loc-RIB best (10.0.0.1 -> 10.0.0.2). Negative: the destination's Loc-RIB group holds exactly one BGP path, peer B's, so install-beside fails. Both clauses (install, replacing) are asserted. Discrimination records verified: revert of rib_remote.go::insertLocRIB reddens both receive-path units.
